استغللت (form X)
# اِسْتَغْلَلْتُ (istaḡlaltu) /is.taɣ.lal.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِسْتَغَلَّ (istaḡalla)
# اِسْتَغْلَلْتَ (istaḡlalta) /is.taɣ.lal.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِسْتَغَلَّ (istaḡalla)
# اِسْتَغْلَلْتِ (istaḡlalti) /is.taɣ.lal.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِسْتَغَلَّ (istaḡalla)
# اُسْتُغْلِلْتُ (ustuḡliltu) /us.tuɣ.
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
